description: Unauthorized touts posing as official ASI heritage guides outside Amer Fort ticket gates.
avoidTip: Only hire guides wearing the official Ministry of Tourism ID card from the licensed ticket booth counter.

description: Drivers offer cheap return trips to Amer Fort in exchange for mandatory visits to high-commission textile and gemstone emporiums.
avoidTip: Firmly instruct your driver 'No shopping stops, direct destination only' before boarding.

description: Auto drivers outside Jaipur Junction main exit refuse meters and quote ₹250-₹300 for short 2-3 km hops into the city.
avoidTip: Walk 50m to the official prepaid traffic police booth or book an app cab / negotiate down to ₹80-₹100.

description: Rooftop restaurants directly facing Hawa Mahal add unlisted 'view surcharges' and mandatory 20% service fees to bills.
avoidTip: Ask to see the printed menu with all taxes and service charges clearly stated before placing orders.

description: Cabs taking tourists uphill to Jaigarh Fort switch to rigged fast meters or demand exorbitant waiting penalties.
avoidTip: Fix an all-inclusive round-trip fare beforehand or use GPS distance tracking in Ride Mode.

description: Touts outside New Delhi Railway Station claim Connaught Place or hotels are closed due to protests or riots to divert travellers to fake travel agencies.
avoidTip: Ignore claims of road closures. Verify with your hotel directly or dial 112 if harassed.

description: Auto drivers outside Paharganj exit run fast-running digital meters or demand extra per-bag luggage surcharges.
avoidTip: Official luggage rule in Delhi allows 1 bag free, ₹7.50 per additional bag. Use the prepaid booth.

description: Bogus 'Government Tourist Information Centers' around Connaught Place Inner Circle selling heavily inflated tour packages.
avoidTip: The only official Delhi Tourism office is Central DTTDC at 88 Janpath. Disregard storefronts with similar names.

description: Men claiming to be ASI officials ask for your entry ticket inside Red Fort and demand an impromptu ₹500 guiding fee.
avoidTip: Never hand your ticket to anyone other than uniformed security at turnstiles.

description: Cycle and e-rickshaws charging ₹200 for a 400m ride between Chandni Chowk metro and Jama Masjid.
avoidTip: The fair standard rate for this stretch is ₹20-₹30 per passenger.

description: Persistent touts claiming Taj Mahal online ticketing is shut down and demanding ₹2,500 for fast VIP entry through back gates.
avoidTip: Taj Mahal tickets are sold exclusively online via asi.payumoney.com or official ASI counters. No VIP fast lane exists.

description: Drivers redirect guests to overpriced 'original marble inlay handicraft' factories where 50% kickbacks are built into prices.
avoidTip: Refuse unscheduled stops. True certified artisans can be found via UP State Emporium Gangotri.

description: Touts mob passengers disembarking from Gatimaan Express at Agra Cantt offering 'free' or ₹20 rides tied to hotel commissions.
avoidTip: Head straight to the UP Police prepaid taxi/auto booth on Platform 1 exit. Never accept a suspiciously cheap ₹20 ride.

description: Street vendors outside Agra Fort selling unofficial shoe covers and paper maps for ₹100 each.
avoidTip: Shoe covers are distributed free or for ₹10 at official counters. Bring socks for hot marble floors.

description: Electric cart drivers between Shilpgram parking and East Gate demanding extra per-passenger baggage fees.
avoidTip: Eco-friendly shuttles are operated by Agra Development Authority with fixed nominal fares.

description: Impostor guides lurking near Badi Pol entrance of Udaipur City Palace giving 15-minute superficial tours for ₹1,200.
avoidTip: Hire the official museum audio guide or certified guides inside the Manek Chowk ticket office.

description: Private touts selling unauthorized boat ride coupons at Lal Ghat for ₹800 claiming official boats are sold out.
avoidTip: Official Lake Pichola boating tickets are issued only at the City Palace Rameshwar Ghat counter (₹400-₹500).

description: Auto drivers outside Udaipur railway station demanding ₹250 for a 2.5 km ride to Jagdish Chowk hotels.
avoidTip: Fair day fare is ₹80-₹90. If driver refuses, walk past the station portico to the main road stand.

description: Lakeside cafes near Ambrai Ghat inflating printed prices at dusk and demanding mandatory minimum spends per seat.
avoidTip: Confirm any minimum order policy before taking a seat.

description: Miniature art painting 'schools' offering free tea and claiming student demonstration, then pressuring for high-price art purchases.
avoidTip: Enjoy the demonstration politely but remember there is zero obligation to purchase.

description: Boatmen at Dashashwamedh Ghat quoting ₹3,000 for a 45-minute evening Ganga Aarti boat ride.
avoidTip: Official district administration capped rates are ₹200-₹300 per seat on shared motor boats or ₹800-₹1,200 for a private row boat.

description: Touts at Manikarnika Ghat claiming to collect 'wood donations for poor families' cremations', demanding ₹2,000-₹5,000.
avoidTip: Strict warning: No charitable wood collection is authorized at the burning ghat. Never pay donation money to individuals here.

description: Auto drivers at Varanasi Cantt claiming old ghat alleys are sealed by police barricades to detour you to partner hotels.
avoidTip: Vehicles simply stop at Godowlia intersection due to pedestrian zones; walk from there to ghats safely.

description: Alley guides claiming to show 'authentic Banarasi silk weaver families' who actually lead you to expensive commission showrooms.
avoidTip: True handloom certified cooperatives can be found at the government Trade Facilitation Centre in Chowkaghat.

description: Self-appointed priests around Kashi Vishwanath temple corridors asking for ₹1,500 'express darshan' tickets.
avoidTip: Book official Sugam Darshan tickets solely online via shrikashivishwanath.org or at the temple trust desk.
